decks.notes: The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's plays with a combination of efficient creatures and instant-speed interaction. By utilizing cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to quickly establish a threatening board presence. Counterspells, Lightning Bolts, and Unholy Heat provide disruption and removal, while Preordain and Expressive Iteration ensure consistent card selection and advantage. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Ledger Shredder adds graveyard synergy and enables further card advantage.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful removal spells and card draw to control the game. With cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage through Night's Whisper and Cling to Dust. The inclusion of Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Sheoldred's Edict offer additional removal options and threats, allowing the player to dictate the pace of the game. The deck also includes utility lands like Blast Zone and Field of Ruin for added versatility. Overall, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through efficient control tactics.

Control the game with a mix of artifacts and counterspells, aiming to create a powerful board presence with Thopter Foundry and Sword of the Meek combo, alongside Urza, Lord High Artificer. Use Urza's Saga to tutor for key pieces like Portable Hole and Thopter Foundry. Disrupt opponents with counterspells like Metallic Rebuke and Esper Sentinel. Utilize versatile artifacts like Shadowspear and Relic of Progenitus to control the battlefield. The deck focuses on generating value through small artifacts and outlasting opponents with a resilient board presence.

The main idea of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo using equipment cards like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to quickly take down opponents. The deck focuses on using Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid to equip creatures with these powerful equipment cards for fast, explosive wins. By combining efficient mana ramp, protection from removal spells, and powerful equipment cards, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with large, unblockable creatures in a short amount of time.

The main goal of this deck is to use creatures with various abilities to tutor for specific creatures as needed, creating a toolbox of options to deal with different situations. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can find key pieces like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to generate value and control the board. Additionally, the deck can create incremental advantages through cards like Blood Artist and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons, while also having strong finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out games.

The deck focuses on quickly milling the opponent's library using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Fractured Sanity while also controlling the board with cards like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push. It uses Archive Trap and Tasha's Hideous Laughter to punish opponents for searching their library, setting up for a win condition of decking out the opponent. The deck also includes disruption cards like Surgical Extraction and Echoing Truth to answer opponent's threats. The goal is to efficiently mill the opponent's library while maintaining control of the game.

This deck focuses on playing powerful spells with Cascade mechanics to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays. By utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, the deck can generate value and board presence quickly. The deck also includes countermagic and removal spells to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect its own threats. With a mix of efficient creatures and disruptive spells, the deck aims to pressure opponents while maintaining control over the game tempo. The key is to cascade into high-impact spells and overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize.

The main idea of this Mono Black Control deck is to focus on resource denial and disruption, using cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's hand and cards like Relic of Progenitus to disrupt their graveyard. The deck also aims to generate mana advantage with Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth, while also utilizing cards like Fatal Push and Field of Ruin for removal. The deck also includes win conditions like Karn, the Great Creator and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, with Profane Tutor and March of Wretched Sorrow to search for key cards.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Leyline Binding early in the game. It also includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to provide control and card advantage. The deck aims to surprise and overwhelm opponents with unexpected plays and combos, utilizing a mix of powerful creatures, efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending, and disruption like Spell Pierce. The main strategy is to outvalue and outpace opponents through a combination of creativity and combo potential.

This deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's hand and board while quickly dealing damage. It utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to strip away key cards from the opponent's hand, while using cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Fury to apply pressure and push damage through. The deck also has some utility in the form of removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt, as well as disruption with Blood Moon. Overall, the goal is to control the game early on and close it out quickly with a mix of efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using cards like Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan to combo off and assemble the key pieces of the deck, such as Urza's Saga and the Mycosynth Gardens. The goal is to efficiently search for lands and generate large amounts of mana to play powerful threats like Primeval Titan and Boros Garrison. The use of bounce lands and utility lands like Vesuva and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, helps to create a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with high-powered creatures.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of burn, counter spells, and powerful creatures in the UR color combination. The key strategy is to apply constant pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while using versatile spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the board. The deck also includes card draw and selection to maintain momentum and adapt to different situations. It aims to win quickly through a combination of creature damage and direct spells, keeping the opponent on the back foot.

This deck focuses on utilizing creature-based combos and tutoring creatures from your deck with Chord of Calling to create a toolbox of creatures tailored to the situation. The deck includes efficient creatures like Wall of Roots and Young Wolf, as well as powerful combo pieces like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. Eldritch Evolution provides additional tutoring options, while cards like Blood Artist and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse offer alternate win conditions. The deck aims to outvalue and overwhelm opponents with its versatile creature toolbox.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler early on, while disrupting opponents with countermagic like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck also utilizes efficient removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to control the board. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration provide card selection and card advantage to keep the pressure on the opponent. The mana base ensures consistent access to all the colors needed for the spells in the deck. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a quick victory.

The deck aims to quickly disrupt the opponent's strategy with Thoughtseize and Grief, while maintaining a fast and aggressive pace with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Fury. Blackcleave Cliffs and Blood Crypt provide the mana base for the deck, while Dauthi Voidwalker and Feign Death offer additional disruption and trickery. Blood Moon can further disrupt opponents relying on nonbasic lands, and cards like Terminate provide removal options. The overall strategy is to apply pressure early and control the game tempo, leading to a swift victory.

This deck focuses on playing powerful Cascade cards to overwhelm opponents with fast, aggressive plays. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can quickly put pressure on opponents while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Mystical Dispute. The deck also includes a mix of creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Murktide Regent to provide additional threats. Additionally, the deck utilizes a variety of land cards to ensure consistent mana production and enable the cascade mechanic effectively.
